annotation.title_en: Cookie Information Notice (Grand National Assembly of Türkiye) - AI Bill page
annotation.authors_or_issuer: TBMM Başkanlığı (Grand National Assembly of Türkiye)
annotation.summary_en: Cookie privacy notice from the Turkish Grand National Assembly website, captured instead of the AI bill text. It explains the use of strictly necessary first-party session and persistent cookies under Turkish data protection law (KVKK No. 6698). It contains no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Only strictly necessary first-party session and persistent cookies are used
Processing is based on legitimate interest under KVKK Article 5(2)(f)
Data subjects may apply under KVKK Article 11 via the Personal Data Protection Authority
Personal data linked to IP is not transferred to other controllers
